svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, 50 - 60 Hz, two inputs (IEC C14), built-in supplies
svg.data-power-redundancy: only one supply is active at a time and the other is for redundancy (quick guide)
svg.data-cooling: passive heatsinks with two fans that switch on when hot
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: the SFP+ cages support both 1.25 Gb SFP and 10 Gb SFP+ modules, with DDMI support, none included
